TEST_CASE.Description: Reject satellite insertion with negative altitude (Altitude <= 0)
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Signal 45000: Altitude must be strictly greater than 0
Signal 45000: Perigee altitude cannot exceed Apogee altitude

TEST_CASE.Description: Reject debris velocity out of physical bound (Velocity > 15 km/s)
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Signal 45000: Debris orbital velocity must be realistic

TEST_CASE.Description: Auto-create Critical Alert on high risk conjunction (Prob >= 1e-4)
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: ALERT row created with alert_level = CRITICAL, AUDIT_LOG entry created

TEST_CASE.Description: Archive previous orbital elements on satellite update
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Row archived into ORBIT_STATE_HISTORY with timestamp

TEST_CASE.Description: Execute Get_Top10_Risky_Debris ranking top collision threats
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Returns up to 10 rows ordered by Max_Collision_Risk DESC

TEST_CASE.Description: Recursive CTE lineage graph query on fragment catalog ID
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Returns fragment tree with Generation_Level hierarchy

TEST_CASE.Description: Cursor iteration for emergency conjunction escalation
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: Iterates cursor and returns Total_Events_Escalated count

TEST_CASE.Description: Validate orbit classification logic across altitude thresholds
Partition pruning EXPLAIN plan on OBSERVATION by year
TEST_CASE.Input_Data: EXPLAIN SELECT ... WHERE observed_at BETWEEN 2026-01-01 AND 2026-12-31

TEST_CASE.Description: Enforce read-only restriction for Researcher role
TEST_CASE.Input_Data: Researcher role executing DELETE FROM SATELLITE

TEST_CASE.Description: Demonstrate Savepoint rollback on partial batch failure
TEST_CASE.Input_Data: START TRANSACTION; SAVEPOINT sp1; ROLLBACK TO sp1; COMMIT;
TEST_CASE.Expected_Result: State preserved at savepoint without rolling back entire transaction
